# History Rewrite (2026-10-17)

On 2026-10-17, history was rewritten so that test fixtures and handoff notes
from 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-17 no longer contain a real person's name or
other terms copied from the owner's library. `git filter-repo --replace-text`
changed only those strings: the files, images and commit messages are
otherwise the same. Commits up to 2026-10-12 kept their hashes, including
`45eb491`, which Hosting pins in `go.mod`.

Docs and deploy evidence written before the rewrite cite the old hashes.
Look an old hash up below (old → new, first 12 characters). Deploy image tags
such as `2a30efe-batch1` keep their old names. The next app-only deploy diffs
against the **new** hash of the last deployed commit (for `2a30efe-batch1`,
that's `70e3f274ea5d`).
